turns.message: 2023年按购买数量降序排名前3的曲目，返回曲目编号和购买数量；并列按曲目编号升序。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT t.track_id,SUM(il.quantity) AS value FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id=il.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date>=DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY value DESC,t.track_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT t.track_id,SUM(il.quantity) AS value FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id=il.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date>=DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY value DESC,t.track_id ASC LIMIT 5
